title: Abelian quotients and the largest orbit sizes of linear groups of odd order
summary: Let $G$ be a finite nonabelian group of odd order, let $p$ be the smallest prime divisor of $|G|$, and let $V$ be a finite faithful completely reducible $G$-module, possibly of mixed characteristic. Suppose that $M$ is the largest orbit size in the action of $G$ on $V$. It is known that $|G:G'|\le M$, and that equality holds only for abelian groups if $|G|$ is odd. We prove that $|G:G'|\le M/p$, unless $p=3$ and $G$ is the direct product of an abelian group and a group isomorphic to $Γ(2^3)$ or to $Γ(2^3)\times C_3$ acting on $V$ in a specific way, in which case $|G:G'|=3M/7$.
